def process():
    total, threshold = map(int, input().split())
    probabilities = list(map(float, input().split()))
    for i in range(total):
        if abs(probabilities[i]) < 1e-6:
            print("0 ", end='')
            continue
        subset_size = total - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << subset_size)
        p = []
        index = 0
        for j in range(total):
            if j != i:
                p.append(probabilities[j])
        dp[0] = probabilities[i]
        result = dp[0]
        for mask in range(1, 1 << subset_size):
            sumP = 0.0
            sum_ = 0.0
            count = 0
            for t in range(subset_size):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += p[t]
                    sum_ += p[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    count += 1
            dp[mask] = sum_ / (1 - sumP)
            if count < threshold:
                result += dp[mask]
        print(f"{result} ", end='')

def main():
    test_cases = 1
    for _ in range(test_cases):
        process()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
